args.message: Revenue is the sum of orders.amount for orders dated 2025-01-01 to 2025-03-31, grouped by the customer's region. No status filter was applied. Every Q1 2025 order had a customer with a known region, so there is no null group. The four regions add up to the Q1 total of 28807.26 across 449 orders.
